smb.label: Samba
smb.help: A shared folder on the local network (Windows, NAS).
smb.intro: The share must hold a “roms” folder, sorted by console.
smb.addressHelp: The server then the share, for example nas/games. The port, on the right, if it is not the default one.

webdav.label: WebDAV
webdav.help: An online folder reachable over WebDAV (Nextcloud, NAS).
webdav.intro: The folder must hold a “roms” folder, sorted by console.
webdav.addressHelp: The server and its path, for example cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav/files/name/. The port, on the right, if it is not the default one.
webdav.passwordHelp: The password, or an app password.

kdrive.label: kDrive
kdrive.help: An Infomaniak kDrive, through its API.
kdrive.intro: The folder must hold a “roms” folder, sorted by console.
kdrive.addressHelp: The number after /app/drive/ in your kDrive address.

ftp.label: FTP
ftp.intro: The folder must hold a “roms” folder, sorted by console.
ftp.addressHelp: The server's name or IP address. The port, on the right, if it is not the default one.

sftp.label: SFTP
sftp.intro: The folder must contain a "roms" folder, sorted by console.
sftp.addressHelp: The server's name or IP address. The port, on the right, if it is not the default one.
sftp.passwordHelp: This account's password, empty if it has none.
